description: Transformer-based synthetic text detector using desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01 (DeBERTa-v3-large mean-pooling head) with overlapping 510-token window aggregation, sentence-level GPT-2 perplexity/burstiness, linguistic stylometry, minimum-length gating, and opt-in Binoculars-small corroboration.

performance.measured_on: NVIDIA RTX 3050 4GB fp16 (Desklib v1.01 + GPT-2 perplexity on 440 interim MAGE texts)

known_failure_modes.effect: insufficient lexical and perplexity statistics; service returns status='not_applicable' with neutral confidence=0.50
reduced discriminative stability; confidence is linearly attenuated toward 0.50 and flagged short_text_attenuated

known_failure_modes.condition: post-cutoff LLMs and heavily paraphrased synthetic prose
known_failure_modes.effect: higher false-negative rate for unadapted as-is desklib checkpoint until Task 3 LoRA adapter is loaded
divergent chunk scores across sections; flagged chunk_disagreement for Debate cross-examination

reliability_notes: Primary text authenticity detector for >=150-word documents. Below 40 words returns not_applicable; 40-149 words is attenuated toward 0.50. Runs in fp16 within a 4-8 GB GPU budget using dynamic-padded batch_size=4 with automatic OOM backoff.
